request: My laptop won't turn on at all, it's completely dead, had it about 3.5 years now.
notes: 3.5-year-old laptop reported dead. KB-03 requires 3 years for replacement eligibility; ASSET-Q2-2026 sets 4-year refresh cycle. Policy conflict must be surfaced. Reported failure is not verified hardware failure. Diagnosis must precede replacement routing.

request: Can I get Wi-Fi access for a guest visiting our office tomorrow?
notes: Self-service via front-desk kiosk. 24-hour validity. No IT ticket needed.

request: I'm locked out of my account, tried my password 6 times.
notes: 6 failed attempts exceeds the 5-attempt threshold in KB-01. KB-01 requires manual IT unlock (not just a password reset). A reset is already queued — the existing action should be updated to include manual unlock, not treated as a duplicate.

request: Need approval to install a data-analysis tool that's not in the software catalog.
notes: Non-catalog software. Security review already pending per KB-04. Do not duplicate or restart. Timeline: 3-5 business days from submission.

request: My VPN stopped working this morning, says credentials expired.
notes: VPN credentials expire every 90 days per KB-02. Employee is responsible for renewal. No renewal URL is supplied in source data.

request: Printer on the 3rd floor keeps showing 'paper jam' even though there's no jam.
notes: Technician already assigned per KB-05 workflow. Continue existing investigation. Confirm queue/spooler checks. Asset tag should be collected if not already on file. Avoid duplicate assignment.

request: I've started working from home 4 days a week, how do I get a monitor?
notes: 4 remote days/week exceeds the KB-10 threshold of 'more than 3 days/week'. Eligibility is confirmed but approval is not. Requires manager sign-off then Finance processing. IT handles shipping only after both approvals. One-time allowance — prior usage must be checked.

request: I think I got a phishing email asking for my login — forwarding it to a few teammates to check.
notes: KB-09: Must report to security@chillstack.example immediately. CRITICAL: Employee must NOT forward to teammates — this is explicitly prohibited by KB-09. Auto-escalation to Security already in place. Keep Security involved. Advise stopping forwarding immediately.

request: My mailbox is full and I can't send emails.
notes: KB-06: Default 25GB; archive old mail first. Increases above 25GB require manager approval; absolute cap is 50GB. Never grant unlimited space.

request: Can someone give me admin access to the finance reporting server? Need it urgently for month-end.
notes: No supplied policy authorises finance-server admin access. Must ask for business justification and route to human access reviewer. Urgency does not grant permission. Reference TK-1050 (admin access rejected for missing justification) as closed precedent — it does not block this case but the pattern is relevant.

request: New contractor joining my team next week, they'll need VPN access.
notes: KB-02: Contractors require manager approval via the access request form. Do not apply the full-time employee auto-grant rule. Nikhil (manager) must submit the approval via the access request form.

request: I can't log into the expense tool, keeps saying invalid credentials.
initial_action: Waiting on employee response (asked for a screenshot, no reply yet)
notes: KB-08: Finance grants access; IT handles technical issues only if account exists. Key question: does an account exist? Waiting for screenshot. Do not ask for passwords. Preserve waiting state.

request: Laptop screen is flickering on and off, had it 2 years, might just need a fix not a replacement.
notes: 2-year-old laptop with screen flickering. Below KB-03 3-year threshold and ASSET-Q2-2026 4-year threshold. Diagnosis and repair is the correct first step. Do not route to replacement without verified hardware failure.

request: Requesting approval to install a browser extension for productivity tracking.
notes: KB-04: Catalog membership unknown. Must first ask whether the extension is in the approved catalog. If confirmed non-catalog, route to IT Security review. Do not assume catalog membership in either direction.

request: hey can you help, its not working
notes: Vague request. Must ask: which device or application, what is the error or symptom, and when did it start. Follow-up information should change the next step. Do not repeat the same questions indefinitely.
